subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】went camping 去野营; went fishing 去钓鱼; rode a horse 骑马; rode a bike 骑自行车; hurt my foot 弄伤脚; ate fresh food 吃新鲜食物; took pictures 拍照; bought gifts 买礼物; fell off 跌落
【重点句型】Where did you go? 你去哪里了？ I went to ... 我去了…… What did you do? 你做了什么？ How did you go? 你怎么去的？ It was ... 它（过去）是……
【A Let's talk】Amy: Where did you go over the winter holiday? Zhang Peng: I went to Sanya. Amy: What did you do? Zhang Peng: I took pictures and went swimming. Amy: How did you go? Zhang Peng: By plane.
【Read and write】I went to Xinjiang last summer. I went there by train. I rode a horse and went camping. I took many pictures. I ate fresh food and bought gifts. My friend fell off his bike and hurt his foot. We had a good time.
key_points: Where did you go? 你去哪里了？
What did you do? 你做了什么？
How did you go? 你怎么去的？
